                                          Solo?
                                          Not for long.
                                          
        
                                          Most of our guests arrive knowing nobody. By the welcome dinner that’s over, and by the end you’ve got a group chat that keeps going long after the flight home.
                                          
        
                                          Our hostels are full of good, genuine people from all walks of life: the average age is over 23, and everyone is in the same boat, here to travel and make memories while they do it. Get on board with us and the real travelling starts.

                                              Timed to
                                              the moon.
                                              
      
                                              Southeast Asia’s biggest nights follow the lunar calendar. We build each festival trip backwards from the night itself, so you arrive knowing what it means and leave having been part of it.
                                              
      
                                              
    
                                              
  
                                              
  
                                              
    
                                              
      
                                              
        
                                              Big days.
                                              
        
                                              The moments a whole town comes out for. Some are our festival trips; the rest land on our regular departures if you pick the right week. We show you which.
                                              
      
                                              
      
                                              
      
                                              Photos show the place, not the day itself. Dates marked expected follow the lunar calendar and are confirmed when they’re announced.
                                              
    
                                              
    
                                              
      
                                              The build-up
                                              We arrive days early. You learn what the night means from people who celebrate it, and make the thing you’ll carry into it: a krathong, a fire boat, your word for the year.
                                              
      
                                              The night
                                              Right in it, with locals, not watching from a coach. Your trip lead knows where to stand, when to arrive and how to join in properly.
                                              
      
                                              The comedown
                                              Then somewhere wild to recover: a canyon, a river, an island. The festival is the peak of the trip, not the end of it.

                                                      Meet the
                                                      country.
                                                      
      
                                                      The views get you on the plane. The people are what you talk about after. Six things happen on every ALL IN trip, whichever one you pick.
                                                      
    
                                                      
    
                                                      
      
                                                      Eat at a family’s table
                                                      At least one meal in a local home on every trip, cooked by the people who live there.
                                                      
      
                                                      Get blessed
                                                      A monk’s water blessing in Cambodia, baci strings in Laos, a melukat spring in Bali.
                                                      
      
                                                      Make something
                                                      A krathong, a silk lantern, a bánh chưng, a canang offering. Your hands remember it longer than your camera.
                                                      
      
                                                      Learn the words
                                                      Three words before you land. Your trip lead makes sure you actually use them.
                                                      
      
                                                      Join a celebration
                                                      A festival, a fiesta, a temple day. Joined the way locals show you, not watched from a bus.
                                                      
      
                                                      Go with someone from there
                                                      Historians, healers, riders and boat crews who live there, not guides reading a script.

Pick a country.

                                                        Good
                                                        questions.
                                                        
    
                                                        
      
                                                        Are flights included?
                                                        No. Flights are never included in an ALL IN trip: you book them, and we’ll suggest the right flight for your dates. Every transfer between stops by road, rail or boat is included, and on the Island Hopper every leg is by boat.
                                                        
      
                                                        What if a festival date moves?
                                                        Lunar festivals are fixed by temple and government calendars, sometimes only a few months ahead. We show expected dates, confirm each one as soon as it’s announced, and move the departure with it so you still land on the night.
                                                        
      
                                                        What if a festival is cancelled?
                                                        It happens. Phnom Penh called off its national boat races in 2025 and 2026, though the provinces still celebrated. Every festival trip has a backup night planned in advance, and the rest of the trip runs as normal.
                                                        
      
                                                        Can I release a sky lantern in Chiang Mai?
                                                        Not in the city, where releasing sky lanterns is banned. Mass releases happen at licensed, ticketed events outside town, which we offer as an optional Level Up. Floating your krathong on the river is included on the trip.
                                                        
      
                                                        Won’t Nyepi waste a day of my trip?
                                                        It’s the point. For 24 hours all of Bali stops: no lights, no traffic, no flights, no going out, for locals and visitors alike. We plan the day at the hostel so it becomes the quietest, darkest-sky day you’ll ever have.
                                                        
      
                                                        Is Songkran safe?
                                                        It’s the happiest, wettest week in Thailand and also one of the busiest on the roads. Nobody on the trip rides a scooter over Songkran, phones go in dry bags, and we stay on foot in the old city.
                                                        
      
                                                        How much does a trip cost?
                                                        Every trip has one price per person, for everything in its itinerary except flights: the beds, every transfer, the tours, the welcome dinner, a meal at a family’s table and the finale. Days you add before or after it are estimated, and a real person on our crew confirms your price before you pay anything.
                                                        
      
                                                        When is the balance due?
                                                        Seven days before you leave, charged to the card you paid the deposit with, with a reminder first. For trips the crew prices, you choose: all now, a week before you go, or in instalments if you leave 60 or more days from now.
                                                        
      
                                                        What’s your refund policy?
                                                        The $99 deposit is non-refundable. The balance is fully refundable up to 60 days before departure, 50% refundable up to 30 days before, and non-refundable after that. If we cancel a departure, you get a full refund automatically.
                                                        
      
                                                        What if my plans change?
                                                        You can swap your dates, gift your spot to someone else, or keep it for later with the Lifetime Deposit Guarantee.
                                                        
      
                                                        Will I be the only solo traveller?
                                                        Not at all. Most of our guests arrive knowing nobody, crews are capped at 20, and the average age of our guests is over 23. Tick the box at checkout and we’ll introduce you to others on the same departure before you fly.
                                                        
      
                                                        Can I add days before or after?
                                                        Yes. Make it yours adds any of our 23 Mad Monkeys either side of a trip, with the real bus, boat or train between them and the tours you pick. The night before an ALL IN trip starts is on us, subject to availability: say yes when you book and we book your bed.
                                                        
      
                                                        When does ALL ASIA leave?
                                                        Every month. Each departure runs the six countries in the order the weather likes best at that time of year, so a January departure starts on the first Island Hopper of the year and an October one catches the fire boats in Luang Prabang and Yi Peng in Chiang Mai.
                                                        
      
                                                        Can I do just part of ALL ASIA?
                                                        Yes. Every chapter is one of our regular departures, so you can book any of them on its own and travel with that country’s crew.
                                                        
      
                                                        What do the patches get me?
                                                        Every trip ends with its own patch, numbered for your crew. Every Mad Monkey on the trip counts toward Mad Loyalty, Mad Monkey’s free rewards programme: five different Mad Monkeys makes you MADDEST, with two free nights in a new country and a free pub crawl every month. On top of that, two patches get you a free Level Up, three get you the ALL IN jacket and all six get you the black card. Every trip also has Trip Bingo: nine squares from its own days, signed off by your trip lead.
                                                        
      
                                                        Can I just ask a question first?
                                                        Yes. Tap Enquire, tell us a bit about what you’re after and it opens your email app with a message to Ewan filled in. A real person replies. Or ask Ewan on WhatsApp.
                                                        
      
                                                        Do I need travel insurance?
                                                        Yes, it’s required. SafetyWing and World Nomads are good options.
                                                        
      
                                                        I used a creator code. What do I get?
                                                        You’re entered into a prize draw for a 7-Day Indonesia ALL IN trip, and 2 free nights are added to your Mad Monkey loyalty account, valid for 3 months from your booking date.
                                                        

      
                                                        Is it OK to join in if it isn’t my religion?
                                                        Yes. Visitors are welcome at all of these festivals. Join in the way your hosts show you, dress for the temple, and ask before you photograph a ceremony.
